scope: Global Favorites category controls and restoration of category-membership picker panels; measured entry and lazy Favorites growth only.
limitations: Both builds use Node22.23.4 and full 40-character clean source identities. The baseline dependency symlink is locally ignored; the shared installed dependency graph was checked against the identical lockfile.
The candidate build emitted all assets and stopped at six pre-allowance raw size violations; this record does not claim that original build passed.
The entry allowance includes 20 gzip bytes for subsequent source-identity variation. Final source-stamped CI and release artifacts must still pass the size gate.
